hotels.title: Vietnam Beachfront Escape with All-Inclusive Dining, Massages & Nightly Cocktails
hotels.description: Escape to this family-friendly hideaway on a serene stretch of coastline 2.5 hours from Ho Chi Minh City, surrounded by verdant forests and sparkling beaches, where sunset comes paired with poolside cocktails. When you’re not outside exploring, dine on delicious Mediterranean fare at Azura, taste-test Vietnamese classics at Nook or relax with a quick snack in the vibrant interiors of Nest. While the kids enjoy Play Play Kids' Club, take a moment for self-care at the soothing Angsana Spa, which incorporates fragrant herbs and botanicals into its therapies and treatments. Wander just minutes from this serene Banyan Tree-owned retreat to explore the crystalline surf of Ho Tram Beach, float away at the Binh Chau Hot Springs, or admire the overwhelming beauty of the Binh Chau-Phuoc Buu Nature Reserve.
